description: This file defines the class SyncInboundEmailAccountsSubActionHandler, which handles sub-actions related to inbound email account synchronization within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for managing email sync processes, handling IMAP connections, processing email headers, and outputting status messages.

classes.name: SyncInboundEmailAccountsSubActionHandler
classes.description: Handles sub-actions for syncing inbound email accounts, including initializing connections, processing emails via IMAP, managing output logging, and handling errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler and processes the requested sub-action, handling exceptions accordingly.

methods.name: getRequestedSubAction
methods.description: Retrieves the sub-action method name from the request, defaults to 'index', and validates its type.

methods.name: action_Index
methods.description: Displays the main inbound email configuration form.

methods.name: getInboundEmailRows
methods.description: Fetches all active, non-deleted inbound email account records.

methods.name: getEmailBean
methods.description: Retrieves an Email bean by its ID.

methods.name: getInboundEmailBean
methods.description: Retrieves an InboundEmail bean by its ID.

methods.name: action_Sync
methods.description: Performs the email synchronization process across multiple inbound email accounts, including IMAP connection handling and email processing.

methods.name: handleIMAPErrors
methods.description: Checks and logs any IMAP errors or alerts found during processing.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the output log file if it exists.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Appends a message to the output log file, throwing exception on failure.

methods.name: getIMAPUID
methods.description: Finds the IMAP UID corresponding to a message ID MD5 within headers.

methods.name: getEmailIdsOfInboundEmail
methods.description: Retrieves email IDs associated with a specific inbound email account, validating the ID.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Executes a SQL SELECT query and returns results as an array, throwing exception if empty.

methods.name: getEmailHeadersOfIMAPServer
methods.description: Connects to the IMAP server, retrieves email headers, and computes message ID MD5s.

methods.name: getCompoundMessageIdMD5
methods.description: Generates a MD5 hash combining message ID and delivery info, used to identify emails uniquely.

methods.name: isOrphanedEmail
methods.description: Determines if an email is orphaned by comparing message IDs with headers.

methods.name: getRequestedInboundEmailAccounts
methods.description: Gets the list of selected inbound email account IDs from request, defaulting to all.
